description:
Welcome to LunarEdge!

We are a team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, working on the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge.

Our goal is to develop an interactive and user friendly platform that helps explore and compare potential lunar landing sites using NASA data.

You don't need to be an expert in everything. We value creativity, teamwork, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and build something meaningful together.

Let's help shape the future of lunar explore!
